name: Commira
otherNightReminder: Wake up the Commira and have them choose a player, put the Commira's *Dead* reminder token on that player. Then show them the *Cauldron* and have them pick up to 3 players (their choice) and put them back to sleep. Put a potion on each of the chosen players.
ability: Each night*, choose a player; they die. Then eye the cauldron and choose up to 3 players to receive a potion.
flavor:
Although mankind runs, ever fearful, from that pale rider, Death—
scouring the globe for a hidden key to save them from reckoning—
I have no need for secret salvation.
